articles.summary: Struggling to scale Infrastructure as Code? This post explains why CI/CD pipelines and Git workflows break down for modern cloud infrastructure, how brittle IaC practices slow teams, and why a new foundation—pipeline-less delivery with built-in policy, compliance, and orchestration—can help DevOps scale and empower developers safely.
articles.title: 15 Years of Duct Tape: Why IaC Adoption Stalled at 30%
